name: Pepita
description:
Build and run a real website without leaving the chat. Pepita hosts the site; Claude does the work — spin up a new site that's live immediately, read and rewrite copy and sections, and publish changes to your {slug}.pepita.page address or custom domain, with preview links to share before you go live.

Beyond pages: content like blog posts, recipes or products — anything you show more than one of. Claude writes and updates the items, and new ones stay drafts until you publish them. Forms collect submissions with no backend of your own, so Claude can count them, read them back, hand you a spreadsheet, or write the confirmation email each one sends — and all of it is equally editable in pepita's in-browser editor at pepita.dev.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pepita to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pepita to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.pepita.dev/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pepita MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pepita lists 37 MCP tools, including list_sites, create_site, get_site_status, list_site_files, read_site_file, write_site_file, publish_site, create_preview, list_previews, update_preview, delete_preview, and list_content_templates.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pepita?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Pepita in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Pepita requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pepita is developed by Pepita. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
